concept_definition: A utensil with a handle and two or more prongs used for spearing and lifting food to eat, or for holding food in place while cutting.
A small, usually rounded utensil with a shallow bowl and a handle, used for eating, stirring, or serving food and liquids.
a small, open container, typically with a handle, used for drinking liquids such as tea or coffee
a shallow, typically round dish used for serving or eating food

a written or printed work consisting of pages bound together along one edge and usually protected by a cover; a single work of literature or non-fiction, or a collection of sheets compiled for reading, study, or reference.
A small metal instrument used to operate a lock by fitting into its mechanism and turning to open or close it; (also) any device or code that provides access or control.
A device used to make and receive voice calls and often to send messages or access other communication services (i.e., a telephone or mobile phone).
a small timekeeping device worn on the wrist or carried in a pocket that shows the time
a flexible container made of material such as cloth, paper, or plastic, used for carrying or holding items
a small flat case, usually folding, used for carrying paper money, credit cards, and identification documents
A pair of lenses set in a frame worn on the face to correct or protect the eyes (commonly called glasses).
a typically cylindrical container, usually made of glass or plastic, with a narrow neck and a mouth, used for storing and pouring liquids
a container, typically with flat sides and a lid or flaps, used for storing or transporting objects
A thin material made from wood pulp, rags, or other fibrous substances, used for writing, printing, packaging, or wrapping.
a cutting instrument consisting of two metal blades joined so that the sharpened edges slide past each other when the handles are closed, used for cutting paper, cloth, and other thin materials
a smooth, polished surface, typically of glass coated with a metal, that reflects a clear image of objects placed in front of it
a piece of absorbent cloth or paper used for drying or wiping a surface, especially the body or hands after washing
a separate seat for one person, typically with a back and sometimes with arms, designed to be sat on
A handheld cutting tool consisting of a sharp blade and a handle, used for cutting, slicing, or piercing.
A handheld writing instrument that uses ink to make marks on paper or similar surfaces.
A slender hand-held writing or drawing instrument with a graphite (or similar) core encased in wood or other material.
A small handheld tool with a row of teeth used to arrange, untangle, or style hair.
A small brush used for cleaning the teeth and gums.
A thin, flexible length of fiber, thread, or twine used for tying, fastening, or connecting things; a small cord.
A solid block or stick of wax (or similar material) with a central wick that is lit to produce light, and sometimes scent or heat.
A flat or broad kitchen tool used for flipping, turning, spreading, or scraping food or mixtures.
A handheld device with a collapsible fabric canopy on a frame, used to protect a person from rain or sunlight.
A handheld device used to fasten sheets of paper together by driving a metal staple through them.
A soft cushion used to support the head while sleeping or resting.
A large piece of soft material used to cover oneself, especially while sleeping, to provide warmth.
A shallow, typically metal container with a flat bottom and usually a long handle, used for cooking food on a stovetop.
A decorative container, typically made of glass, ceramic, or metal, used for holding cut flowers or for display.
A substance used with water for cleaning or washing, typically forming a lather.
A handheld tool with a sharp blade used for shaving or removing hair from the skin.
A small model of a human, used as a toy for children.
A small object designed for children to play with for amusement or learning.
A pair of thin wooden, bamboo, or metal sticks used as eating utensils to pick up and hold food, commonly used in East Asian cuisines.
a piece of furniture for sleeping
a piece of furniture with a flat top
a group or collection of things
a thing made for sitting on
a ceremonial chair for a sovereign
a short stick for producing fire; a contest
the flat cutting edge of a knife, saw, or other tool or weapon; a thin flat part of something.
a device for giving light, either electric or using oil or gas.
a portable light source, typically a stick with a flame at one end; a flashlight.
